key_points: J&J in talks to sell its DePuy Synthes orthopedics unit to Apollo for ~$20B
Sale would allow J&J to focus on higher‑growth pharma and medtech segments
Stock rose after‑hours on the news, indicating short‑term positive reaction
GuruFocus flags JNJ as ~37% overvalued, presenting a valuation headwind
Deal remains uncertain; timing and final terms could affect impact
